purpose: Prioritized refactoring backlog after rev0016 evidence_ref, graph-edge, and pattern-control repair.

items.title: Upgrade weak source and claim locators
items.success_condition: No claim locator says search locator; source records have durable page/line/section or explicit fragile-locator status.

items.title: Replace overloaded source_support.source_id with typed evidence_refs
items.success_condition: Pattern claims can cite records, sources, and infrastructures without pretending every support object is a source.

items.title: Add control/counterexample requirements to every PAT record
items.success_condition: Every pattern has support, controls, negative-control debt, rollback triggers, and a maturity gate visible in CONTROL-COVERAGE-MATRIX.json.

items.title: Normalize links into graph edges
items.target: links fields and eventual graph_edges surface
items.success_condition: All recurs_with/supports/qualifies/practice_lag/influence edges are queryable without parsing prose.

items.title: Collapse evidence_class and permanence_token sprawl into controlled major/subtype fields
items.success_condition: Cross-domain source-quality queries work without enumerating dozens of near-duplicate values.

items.title: Second-review one full record per promoted lane
items.target: ENG, REP, NEG, GEN, INF, MET, PAT
items.success_condition: Representative records reach second_reviewed with claim locator checks and skeptical-objection notes.

items.title: Build genealogy of correction sample edges
items.success_condition: At least one correction, critique, or safety-method transmission chain is represented with typed evidence-sensitive edges.

items.title: Repair remaining search/snippet locator debt after refined detector
items.success_condition: Remaining weak_source_ids and weak_claim_refs are replaced by stable line/page/section locators or explicit unreachable-source status.

items.title: Audit whether CTL should remain a record type or become a factor axis
items.success_condition: Future sessions can represent controls without over-proliferating record types.

items.title: Add explicit anomaly trajectory fields if physical-science lane expands
items.success_condition: Records can distinguish anomaly announcement, retest, correction, residual learning, public communication, and revival risk without inventing a new record type prematurely.

items.title: Apply hazard-basis factor axes across all engineering records
items.success_condition: Every ENG record has a ledger or schema overlay for hazard basis, state legibility, common-mode exposure, OPEX memory, emergency information, and correction infusion where applicable.

items.title: Stabilize hazard/consequence overlays for engineering records
items.success_condition: Engineering records distinguish mechanism, exposure, warning time, public disclosure, and correction infusion without hardcoding one domain vocabulary.

completed_this_revision.note: All claims now use evidence_refs; source_support removed from promoted records and sources_or_support removed from claim ledger.
Every PAT record now has red_team_controls; actual control records remain future work.
GRAPH-EDGES.json generated; record-local links remain canonical.
SOURCE-VOCABULARY-CONTROL-LEDGER maps raw tokens to major classes; raw source records not destructively migrated.
Weak-locator detector now avoids false positives from “research” and reports explicit IDs; actual locator debt remains.

completed_this_revision.title: Make positive controls first-class for pattern calibration
completed_this_revision.completion_note: Added CTL schema, records, control ledgers, pattern-control updates, and lint/audit support.

completed_this_revision.note: Targeted locator repair on three source records and two claim evidence refs; remaining weak locator debt remains open.

completed_this_revision.title: Introduce hazard-basis factor audit for engineering records
completed_this_revision.note: Added HAZARD-BASIS-AUDIT-LEDGER with six factor axes and mapped rev0023 nuclear records.

completed_this_revision.item: created impoundment factor overlay and hazard-classification refactor ledger

entries.title: Use CONTROL-COVERAGE-MATRIX to prioritize negative controls and counterexamples before pattern maturity
entries.rationale: rev0022 shows most patterns are under-controlled; future revisions should not scale patterns by support-example count alone.

entries.item: Apply process-safety factor axes to legacy BP Texas City and future chemical records; separate recommendation closure from source existence.

entries.summary: Structural lane now needs positive/negative controls, recommendation-closure records, and second-pass source editions.

entries.task: Develop transport-state overlay into optional query/factor vocabulary across aviation, maritime, rail, process-control and medical-device operation records without hard schema migration.
